Each Diner can have zero or more TableBooking records, and each TableBooking belongs to exactly one Diner. Each TableBooking uses exactly one RestaurantService, and each RestaurantService serves zero or more TableBooking records. Each RestaurantService manages one or more Table records by composition, and each Table belongs to exactly one RestaurantService. Each Diner can reference zero or more Table records, and each Table can be referenced by zero or more Diner records.
